businessPurpose: This application allows users to manage their data through a web interface, integrating with various cloud services for data storage and processing.
architectureSummary: On-Premises upstream systems to SaaS Cloud Provider1 to downstreanm applications hosted in Cloud Provider 2
dataFlows: On-Premises Api to SaaS Cloud Provider 1
Cloud Provider 1 to Azure App Gateway
App Gateway to AKS hosting Java Rest API
Python Rest API to Azure Data Storage
App Gateway to AKS hosting Java Rest API
Python Rest API to Azure Data Storage
authenticationDetails: Entra ID for users, Managed Identity for service-to-service, OAuth 2.0 for third-party integrations, with role-based access control (RBAC) implemented for all components.
existingControls: Azure Virtual Network (VNet) with subnets and NSGs
assumptions: No public access to Azure Storage accounts
All data in transit is encrypted
All data at rest is encrypted
Third-party services comply with security standards
